description:
## New

- **Patches update notice (YouTube and YouTube Music):** On launch, checks the public patches releases at most
  once a day and shows the new version with release notes. Choose **Open Manager** (Morphe Manager, or the
  patches release page), **Later**, or **Skip this version**.
- In **Miscellaneous**, choose **Off / Stable / Development** (defaults to the installed patches' channel),
  or use **Check now**. No APK is downloaded: update by re-patching with Manager.

## Fixes

- Settings list dialogs no longer crash when an option is marked as a new setting.

This is a development prerelease, not a stable promotion.

Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-12.
